caseName: Long Beach Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n v. Federal Home Loan Bank
caseNameFull: Long Beach Federal Savings & Loan Association v. Federal Home Loan Bank of San Francisco

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The order entered in this case on April 30, 1956, ante, p. 916, is amended to read as follows: “The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction.”
